_doc: ORDER-834 B2.5 free-week habit visits. Read only by systems/BranchHabit.gd. Once a full run has entered an activity (requires_any / requires_all, none of forbids, and a holding when portfolio is true), a free full-story week may offer one short habit scene. After a week the player went (a choice index in that event's `go`), the activity calls again on the next free week, at most max_streak times in a row, then waits return_gap_after_streak weeks; after a refusal it waits return_gap_after_skip weeks. `visits` counts the weeks the player went; at habitual_visits the regular variant replaces the first one. rest_weeks stay quiet (mourning, finale). A forbids flag stops an activity unless a forbids_unless flag is set: recovery locks gambling until a relapse, as the AP surface did.
